articles.summary: IBM announced four organizations selected for the new education and workforce development cohort of the IBM Impact Accelerator.

articles.summary: The connections accompany expanded AI cost-management capabilities across its portfolio to help organizations forecast spending, evaluate costs against business results and decide which AI investments to scale.
articles.title: Apptio Expands Portfolio to Help Enterprises Connect AI Spending to Business Value

articles.summary: A new report from IBM, Proof, Not Promises: The Digital Sovereignty Index, reveals an “overconfidence gap”: leaders believe they can prove sovereign control of their technology, but the evidence often falls short of the Index’s highest standards.
articles.title: IBM Digital Sovereignty Index: In the AI Era, Control Is No Longer Enough. Enterprises Must Prove It.

articles.summary: IBM announced IBM Quantum Nighthawk r3, its next-gen processor, will be built to accurately execute 10,000 quantum ops across 520 qubits to tackle larger, more complex problems while maintaining the speed & quality demoed by the current gen Nighthawk.
articles.title: IBM Quantum Nighthawk Demonstrates New Levels of Speed and Quality, with Plans to Scale Beyond 1,000 Qubits in 2027

articles.summary: From inference through gateways, agents, and policy controls, the Praxis Policy Engine is a programmable security guard for AI agents.
articles.title: Building policy enforcement into the AI stack with Praxis

articles.summary: IBM Consulting and Microsoft have combined their technologies and expertise with forward-deployed engineering support for qualifying engagements to help enterprises accelerate AI deployment.
articles.title: IBM and Microsoft Announce a New AI Agent Platform Designed for Industry-Specific Transformation

articles.summary: A breakthrough in self-calibration technology is revitalizing an old form of navigation.
articles.title: How MEMS inertial sensors can rival GPS

articles.summary: IBM, the U.S. Department of Energy-funded Quantum Science Center at Oak Ridge National Laboratory , and AMD unveiled a new co-design platform for quantum error correction, integrating quantum and high-performance computing.
articles.title: Oak Ridge National Lab, IBM, and AMD Launch New Co-Design Platform for Quantum Error Correction

articles.summary: IBM, the University of Chicago, the State of Illinois, and Illinois Quantum and Microelectronics Park (IQMP) unveiled an IBM Quantum System Two in Chicago, IBM's first quantum computer in Illinois and the company’s most advanced system available.
articles.title: IBM Unveils Its Most Advanced Quantum Computer in Chicago, Marking a Milestone for Illinois's Quantum Future

articles.title: Confluent Introduces Its Streamhouse Architecture to Power AI With Real-Time Business Context
